reason: The coffee, Wi-Fi and a toddler playing a few feet away fits my work-from-home days, and $12 drop-in is easy to try. I'd come on a rainy day, not sign up for a membership.
objection: We'd go once or twice a month, so $49-59 a month for a membership doesn't pay off. I also don't know if it's actually quiet enough to get work done.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper punch card or 4-visit pass would make me commit more. A membership under about $30 would flip me to joining.
